label: GEM well ID
purpose: Unique ID used in aggregation_GEM_well_IDs, target names and output folders.
details: Keep it stable and avoid dots.

label: Dataset
purpose: Groups related GEM wells in the pre-aggregation QC summaries.
details: A processing and reporting group, not a donor identifier.

label: Donor ID
purpose: Links a single-donor GEM well to its row in the donor metadata table.
details: Use NA for a pooled well, whose donors come from GEM_well_donors_VCF_file.

label: Expected donors
purpose: Number of donors in the GEM well.
details: Use 1 for a single-donor well; for a pooled well, Vireo assigns nuclei to this many donors.

label: Cell Ranger ARC count directory
purpose: Locates the Cell Ranger ARC count output for this GEM well.
details: Point to the directory containing outs, not to outs itself.

label: Use CellBender
purpose: Chooses whether CellBender-corrected GEX counts replace the Cell Ranger counts.
details: When TRUE, GEM_well_cellbender_h5_file must give the CellBender H5 file; otherwise FALSE.

label: CellBender H5 file
purpose: Gives the CellBender-corrected GEX count file.
details: Required when GEM_well_add_cellbender is TRUE; otherwise NA.

label: Donor VCF file
purpose: Donor-genotype VCF that enables demultiplexing of a pooled GEM well.
details: Its sample names become the donor IDs. Use NA for a single-donor well, whose nuclei all receive GEM_well_donor_id.

label: Pre-aggregation QC filters
details: NA for the first run; later, complete R expressions separated by ;;.

label: Active
purpose: TRUE to process the GEM well; FALSE for unused rows, including unused demo wells.
details: Every GEM well selected by an active aggregation must also be active.

label: Cell or nuclei sorting
purpose: Describes sorting or enrichment before library preparation.
details: Example optional metadata column for values such as sorted, depleted, or unsorted material. Add other GEM_well_ columns when your analysis needs them.
